interpretation.analysis_unit: fixed physical world by fresh trajectory replicate
interpretation.caveat: Seed 1 and seed 3 were selected from development results because their observed directions differed. Replicates characterize within-world Codex trajectory variability; they do not turn two selected worlds into a population-level material-information test.

selected_branch.manuscript_language: Fresh trajectories frequently reversed sign within a fixed physical world, indicating that provider-trajectory variability dominated any stable material-information pattern.
